Welcome to The Colony 🇲🇽

The Colony is a role-playing game inspired by different places and situations in Mexico.

• Buy and customize vehicles
• Buy and decorate houses
• Get jobs and earn money
• PVP
• Explore a Mexico full of unique places and situations.
• Roleplay with other players
• And much more!

Check our announcements for upcoming updates, news, and events.

Warning: The use of exploits, toxic behavior, or actions that cause serious problems within the game can result in a ban.

If you need to report a problem, we recommend recording a clip as evidence.
